identity.estimator: fixed-sample untempered completion-mean LoRA score gradient; no KL/head loss
identity.dtype: bfloat16 base, float32 LoRA and accumulators
identity.dropout: train mode for gradient checkpointing; dropout modules p=0 and attention_dropout=0

limitations: Gradient differences do not show which assignment improves learning; historical prompt IDs and generating hashes unavailable
